Target Business Services

Position:		Full Time – Permanent
Location: 		10 Comserv Cl, West Gosford NSW 2250 
Salary: 			$80k - $85k Plus 12% Superannuation

Our client, LL Frame & Truss (NSW) Pty Ltd, is a trusted supplier of precision-engineered timber frames and trusses across NSW. Backed by the founder's 23+ years of experience in the industry, LL Frame and Truss has built a reputation for delivering quality, cost-effective, and sustainable solutions to renowned builders.

The company specialises in prefabricated timber wall frames, roof trusses, laminated veneer lumber, flooring systems, and eaves packages, using advanced Pryda Engineering Software to ensure accuracy, compliance, and production efficiency. With a strong commitment to quality workmanship and reliable service, LL Frame & Truss continues to expand its manufacturing operations throughout NSW.

The client is currently seeking an experienced Wood Machinist to join its production team. This role is responsible for setting up and operating specialised woodworking machinery to manufacture precision timber components used in residential building projects. The successful candidate will play an important role in ensuring that timber products are produced accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

-	Study production drawings, work orders and specifications to determine machining requirements and product dimensions. 
-	Determine appropriate tooling, machine settings and operational sequences for efficient timber processing. 
-	Set up and adjust woodworking machinery for cutting, planing, shaping, drilling, profiling and sanding timber components. 
-	Operate woodworking machines to manufacture timber frames, truss components, flooring systems and other engineered timber products to required specifications. 
-	Inspect finished components to verify dimensions, accuracy and quality, making adjustments where necessary. 
-	Assemble and fasten timber frame components and other prefabricated timber products as required during the manufacturing process. 
-	Carry out routine maintenance, cleaning and safety checks on woodworking machinery and equipment. 
-	Monitor material usage and minimise waste while maintaining production efficiency. 
-	Maintain a safe and organised work environment in accordance with workplace health and safety procedures. 
-	Work collaboratively with supervisors and production staff to ensure manufacturing schedules and customer delivery timeframes are achieved. 

Skills & Qualifications

-	AQF Certificate III in Wood Machining, Carpentry, Joinery or a closely related trade qualification, or equivalent. 
-	Minimum 1 year of full-time work experience as a Wood Machinist or in a similar timber manufacturing role. 
-	Demonstrated experience operating industrial woodworking machinery and equipment. 
-	Ability to read and interpret production drawings, cutting lists and technical specifications. 
-	Sound knowledge of timber materials, machining processes and quality control procedures. 
-	Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate and high-quality workmanship. 
-	Good problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a production team. 
-	Knowledge of workplace health and safety requirements within a manufacturing environment. 

The Successful Applicant

You will be required to work effectively within a team environment while maintaining high standards of accuracy, quality and productivity. Previous experience in timber manufacturing or prefabricated timber frame and truss production will be highly regarded.

Please note only short-listed candidates will be contacted and your application will be treated as strictly confidential.
To apply for this position, email your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au

result.description:
## Technical Writer

## Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer to join our team and produce clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation that supports both internal operations and end-user understanding. This role is central to bridging the gap between complex technical concepts and accessible written content across a range of formats and platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong research capabilities, excellent written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts, developers, and stakeholders. A background in a technical discipline combined with a passion for clear communication would make you an exceptional fit for this position.

## Key Responsibilities

- Research, develop, and maintain a broad range of technical documentation including user manuals, handbooks, training materials, standard operating procedures, and multimedia content

- Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and accurate content tailored to the intended audience, whether end users, internal teams, or stakeholders

- Collaborate closely with engineers, developers, product managers, and subject matter experts to gather information and verify technical accuracy across all documentation

- Plan, organise, and manage documentation projects from initial brief through to final publication, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met

- Review and edit existing documentation to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or outdated content, and update materials to reflect product or process changes

- Develop and apply style guides, templates, and documentation standards to ensure consistency in tone, format, and terminology across all written outputs

- Produce content for digital and print formats including online help systems, knowledge bases, e-learning modules, and technical reference guides

- Liaise with stakeholders to understand documentation requirements and translate business or technical briefs into structured, reader-focused content

- Conduct quality assurance reviews of documentation prior to release, checking for technical accuracy, readability, grammar, and adherence to brand and style guidelines

- Support the development of training materials and contribute to onboarding programmes by producing clear instructional content for new users or staff

- Manage version control and document repositories, ensuring all materials are correctly filed, versioned, and accessible to relevant teams

## Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Technical Writing, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

- Demonstrated experience in a technical writing role, ideally within a corporate, technology, or engineering environment

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy

- Proven ability to research, interpret, and document complex technical subjects in a clear and accessible manner

- Proficiency in documentation tools such as MadCap Flare, Confluence, Microsoft Word, or equivalent platforms

- Experience working with content management systems, version control tools, and document repositories

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines

- Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and build effective relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Sound understanding of documentation best practices, including the use of style guides such as the Microsoft Manual of Style or equivalent

## Preferred Qualifications

- Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Technical Communication, such as a Certificate IV in Professional Writing and Editing or equivalent

- Experience with API documentation, software development lifecycle (SDLC), or working within Agile project environments

- Familiarity with graphic design or multimedia tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Snagit, or Camtasia to support visual documentation

- Exposure to single-sourcing methodologies and structured authoring frameworks such as DITA

- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare, finance, or engineering where documentation compliance is essential

## Why Join Us?

- Flexible working arrangements including hybrid and remote options to support a healthy work-life balance

- A collaborative, inclusive team culture that values expertise, continuous learning, and professional growth

- Access to ongoing training, professional development programmes, and support for further education or industry certifications

- Meaningful work that directly contributes to product quality, customer experience, and organisational knowledge

- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits reviewed annually in line with performance

## Job Details

- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift

- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
We are looking for an experienced and strategic ICT Manager to lead the planning, development, and day-to-day management of our organisation's information and communication technology systems. This role is central to ensuring our technology infrastructure supports business objectives effectively and securely. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical knowledge, sound leadership capability, and the ability to translate complex ICT requirements into practical solutions. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to drive digital initiatives and maintain a reliable, secure, and efficient ICT environment.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse organisational information needs and specify appropriate technology solutions to meet current and future business requirements
Formulate, implement, and continuously review ICT strategies, policies, and operational plans aligned with broader organisational goals
Direct the evaluation, procurement, and installation of ICT hardware, software, and infrastructure, ensuring value for money and fitness for purpose
Oversee the security and integrity of all ICT systems, including risk assessments, data protection compliance, and incident response planning
Set priorities and allocate resources across system development, maintenance, and daily operations to ensure continuity of service
Lead and manage the ICT team, including recruitment, performance management, professional development, and workload planning
Direct the provision of user training and technical support, ensuring staff are equipped to use systems effectively
Manage vendor and contractor relationships, including negotiating contracts, monitoring service levels, and ensuring delivery against agreed outcomes
Develop and manage ICT budgets, tracking expenditure and identifying opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising performance
Oversee the implementation of new systems and technology projects, managing timelines, risks, and stakeholder communication throughout
Ensure ICT operations comply with relevant legislation, industry standards, and internal governance frameworks
Produce and present regular reports on ICT performance, project progress, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
Proven experience in an ICT management or senior technical leadership role, typically five or more years
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement ICT strategies, policies, and operational frameworks
Strong knowledge of network infrastructure, systems administration, cybersecurity principles, and cloud-based technologies
Experience managing budgets, vendor contracts, and procurement processes within an ICT context
Solid understanding of data privacy legislation and information security standards, including ISO 27001 or equivalent
Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to mentor and develop technical teams
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with a structured approach to decision-making
Effective communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience delivering ICT projects using recognised project management methodologies such as PRINCE2 or Agile
Preferred Qualifications
Postgraduate qualification in IT management, business administration, or a related field
Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CISSP, or equivalent
Experience working within regulated industries or government environments
Familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) or customer relationship management (CRM) platforms
Knowledge of COBIT or other IT governance frameworks
Experience leading digital transformation or large-scale systems migration projects
Why Join Us?
Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation that genuinely values technology as a driver of business success
Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including funded certifications and leadership programmes
Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options to support work-life balance
Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation and performance-based incentives
Contribute to meaningful projects that have a real impact on organisational outcomes and service delivery
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
